verdict.rationale: Central credential storage, sharing, and per-credential access control is a fair question for a workflow-automation platform, so the axis applies. The pack has no documentation of shared connections or credential-level permissions. The nearby evidence is off-target: API keys authenticate the platform's own API, the governance page describes build and reach controls in general, audit logs record which account an agent used, and one community comment vaguely praises connections, so none of it counts toward this story.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can store connection credentials centrally, share them with my team, and control who can use which credential
